title: United Kingdom: importer name and address on the product
summary: Where goods are brought into GB from outside the UK, the GB importer's name and a contact address generally must appear on the product, its packaging or an accompanying document. The exact obligation varies by product regime.

sources.title: Placing manufactured products on the market in Great Britain — GOV.UK
sources.note: Drafted from GOV.UK guidance. Importer-marking duties sit in sector regulations rather than one instrument; the per-regime detail is NOT yet established.
